title.es: El de la carta a Fina
title.en: The One With the Letter to Fina

description.es: Marta le escribe una carta a Fina en donde le informa de la muerte de Pelayo, le cuenta que sabe sobre su exilio y le confiesa que aún la ama. Cloe llega al despacho y Marta le comparte que le ha escrito una carta a Fina con la esperanza de que la lea. Marta se muestra vulnerable, le habla de su odio hacia Pelayo y el miedo de que Fina ya no la quiera. Cloe reafirma su apoyo y, en un momento de cercanía, intenta besarla, pero Marta la rechaza.
description.en: Marta writes Fina a letter in which she tells her about Pelayo's death, tells her she knows about her exile, and confesses that she still loves her. Cloe arrives at the office and Marta tells her she has written a letter to Fina in the hope that she'll read it. Marta shows herself vulnerable, speaking of her hatred for Pelayo and her fear that Fina no longer loves her. Cloe reaffirms her support and, in a moment of closeness, tries to kiss her, but Marta pulls away.
